headline: Peru Energy Ministry Warns Informal Miners Risk Illegal Status Without Law
summary: Peruvian Energy Minister Guillermo Shinno warned that informal miners seeking formalization will revert to illegal status if the MAPE law is not passed by December 30.
why: Peru is a global top supplier of copper and gold; regulatory classification changes for informal miners directly impact mineral extraction compliance.

impacts.name: Mining Sector
impacts.why: Reclassifying informal producers as illegal restricts small-scale mining output and trade.
